text:
maria: quick spike — warm-starting v3-int4-lite on long-doc route. small latency win but seeing jitter on long-doc MRR. proposing fractional warmstart: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h with a stability gate. cc @dain @raj

dain: can you paste the key numbers (latency, cost, MRR delta, hallucination) and which slice was affected? what's the canary window?

maria: numbers from the 2h smoke: p95 latency -110ms, p50 -40ms, cost/tokens ~-18%, longdoc-MRR delta -1.7% (CI borderline), hallucination rate +0.0% (no obvious change). slice: long-docs >3k tokens (~0.9% traffic). canary window was 2h smoke at 2% traffic.

sophia: my take — the latency and cost wins are meaningful, but the MRR drop is borderline. propose automatic fallback rules: fallback if (MRR_down >= 1.5% over 2h AND p95_latency_increase >= 150ms) OR hallucination_rate_increase >= 0.5%. add a cooldown of 1h after any rollback. this avoids noise flips. :thumbsup:

raj: worried about oscillation if we let fractional ramps move too fast. suggest: require two consecutive windows (2h each) showing stable metrics before stepping up. use a rolling median smoothing on MRR with window=3 to ignore spikes. also cap slice-level ramp to 5% if slice represents <1% of traffic to avoid noisy signals.

maria: agreed. here's the rough canary config I'm going to push for the warmstart job (small JSON snippet):

```json
{
  "warmstart": [1, 5, 20],
  "window_hours": 2,
  "stability_windows_required": 2,
  "fallback_rules": {
    "mrr_down_pct": 1.5,
    "p95_latency_ms": 150,
    "hallucination_pct": 0.5,
    "cooldown_minutes": 60
  },
  "slice_caps": {
    "min_slice_traffic_pct": 0.2,
    "max_slice_ramp_pct": 5
  }
}
```

canary-bot: smokecheck finished for thread 5412349990 — summary: long-doc slice MRR -1.8% (p=0.07), p95 latency -110ms, p50 -40ms, cost -18%. fallback NOT triggered by rules. flagged: long-doc slice needs shadow + extended sampling. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5412349990

dain: since fallback didn't trigger but MRR is close to threshold, let's do targeted shadowing on the long-doc slice for 12h and reduce the next ramp step from 5% -> 2% until we see 2 consecutive windows stable. also persist evaluation traces for 1M tokens for the slice.

sophia: agree. add an auto-limiter: if slice MRR drop >1% but overall product MRR stable (within 0.5%), do not rollback automatically — instead hold and shadow. only global/regional regressions should trigger hard rollback. helps avoid punting on low-traffic but high-variance slices.

maria: action items: (1) push canary config with stability_windows_required=2 and slice cap, (2) start 12h shadow run for long-doc slice @2% traffic, (3) collect 1M token traces and run eval suite overnight, (4) set a dashboard alert for slice MRR delta >=1% with 30m aggregation. I'll post updates here.

raj: sounds good. one more ops note — add a jitter buffer to the promoter so steps are randomized +/-10% in time to avoid sync spikes across regions.

maria: will do. thanks all.

canary-bot: noted: scheduled warmstart job with revised config; shadow job queued. will update with 12h smoke result. :robot_face:
